reply.shortGloss: to go; to be (health/fit); to fit (clothes)
reply.emotion: in a hurry to get somewhere, purposeful and moving
notes: Aller is one of the most common verbs in French and is irregular. It uses 'être' as the auxiliary verb in compound tenses (e.g., je suis allé).
It is also used with an infinitive to form the near future tense (futur composé), as in 'je vais manger'.

senses.definition: Se déplacer pour aller d'un endroit à un autre.

examples.text: Je vais au marché ce matin.
examples.translation: I am going to the market this morning.
examples.emotion: cheerful and ready for the day, planning a simple errand

senses.definition: Être dans un certain état de santé ou de forme.

examples.emotion: friendly and genuinely interested, greeting a companion warmly

senses.definition: Convenir à quelqu'un, en parlant d'un vêtement ou d'une situation.

examples.text: Cette chemise te va très bien.
examples.translation: This shirt suits you very well.
examples.emotion: approving and encouraging, noticing a nice detail
